assertions.reason: React dashboard shell loaded at /dashboard with header, sidebar nav, main content, and inspector visible; console errors were empty.
Sidebar navigation click changed hash route to #/settings, and direct hash URL navigation to #/skills rendered the correct page; console errors were empty.
Desktop layout zones, collapsible nav/inspector, and pane resizing were observed, but at narrow viewport the nav switched to drawer while inspector drawer behavior/trigger was not observable.
Theme toggled from light to dark and persisted after full page reload (toggle remained on 'Switch to light' and ui-store theme persisted as dark).
F1 opened the help drawer, '/' focused the global search input, and the g then c shortcut sequence navigated to #/chat; console errors were empty.
Footer link 'Open Legacy Dashboard' navigated to /dashboard-legacy and legacy UI rendered; network header capture showed GET /dashboard-legacy returned HTTP 200.

A meaningful empty-state message was observed on Secrets filter ('No keys match this search'), but Runs route showed migration-placeholder content and no explicit loading indicator/empty-state contract for data-fetch pages, so all-page loading/empty requirements were not met.
After navigating Runs -> Settings, browser Back returned to #/runs and Forward restored #/settings; hash-based history navigation behaved correctly.

frictions.description: agent-browser default daemon launch failed with missing libnspr4.so in this environment.
frictions.resolution: Used isolated AGENT_BROWSER_HOME and prefixed LD_LIBRARY_PATH with Playwright bundled libs for each command.

frictions.description: agent-browser network request tracker did not return /dashboard-legacy request entries after navigation.
frictions.resolution: Captured HTTP response headers via curl for GET /dashboard-legacy to record status evidence.
